commentary_title: Low seasonal demand impacts Panamax employability.
commentary_summary: The global Panamax utilisation witnessed a substantial fall, declining to 93.7% in the second week of 2025. | The Panamax tonne-miles index experienced a 2.6% WoW decline, reaching 96.8 points, attributable to seasonally low coal demand from Far East Asian market owing to Chinese new year holiday. | The tonnage waiting at the anchorage at China's discharge ports dropped to 3.4 mdwt, significantly lower compared to the same period in last two years. | The decline in tonnage underway in the east also corroborates the seasonal lull in China's markets.
